book.name: Yohane
book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: Kukamulwa kwa Yesu
Yesu pakayomolite kuyupa, kakibhuka papamu na ahundwa bhake bhakiyomboka kumwambo ya lukemba Kediloni. Akwo kukibhegha kitogholo, ndo Yesu kakiyingila amwo papamu na ahundwa bhake.
Naywo Yuda, yula nkiluka kakipamanya pala, kiyaha Yesu kakibhegha kangughenda na ahundwa bhake akwo maghenda maghenda.
Habhu Yuda kakighenda ku kitogholo, pakilongoha kimati kya machonda bha Akaaloma na amoo bha mahofisa bhaahumite kwa hilongohi bha andundami na Afalisayu, pabhabhegha na mambamba na mikoha.
Yesu kakimanya ghala ghoha ghaapala kuntulukila, kakilibwitukiha mu ulongolo ghwabhe na kakiakonya, “Mungunpalaha ghani?”
Bhombe bhakinnyanga “Yesu ywa ku Nasaleti.” Yesu kakiaghombela, “Ndo nenga.” Naywo Yuda ywakankilukite Yesu kayima papamu nabho.
Yesu pakaaghombilite, “Ndo nenga.” Bhombe bhakibhuya kihengele nyuma na kughwegha pahi.
Yesu kakiakonya kangi, “Mungumpalaha ghani?” Bhombe bhakinnyanga, “Yesu ywa ku Nasaleti.”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nenga nubhaghombela kala kukita ndo nenga, kya habhu handa mungumbalaha nenga mubhaleke abha bhandu bhaghende.”
Yesu kakilongela habhu ili ghabhonekane ghala ghakalongelite, “Bhala bhaghumbeghite nunhobheha ng'obhe hata yumu.”
Hino, Simoni Petili kakibhegha na lukechelo, kakiluhomola na kakinndumula lichikilo lya kunnilo ndumindumi ywa Ndundame Nkulu, na nndumidumi aywo kakikemwa lihina lyake Maliko.
Yesu kakinng'ombela Petili. “Ghulubhuyile lijambia lyako munchako ghwake! Bhuli, nnobho ghwakambeghite Tate, nenga ngotoke kughunyweghela?”
Yesu kanguyeghwa kwa Ndundame Nkulu
Hino, bhala machonda bha Akaaloma na kilongohi ywabhe na akingikiha bha Akaayahudi bhakinkamula Yesu, bhakimmopa,
kalongohi bhakinnyegha kwa Anasi. Aywo Anasi kakibhegha nkohano ywake Kayafa, ywene ywakabheghite Ndundame Nkulu ywa manjubha ghala.
Kayafa ndo yula ywakaapeghite unyeghelehi Akaayahudi kukita yinnogha mundu yumu kahweghe kwakya bhandu.
Petili kangunkana Yesu
Simoni Petili papamu na nhundwa yungi bhakintughila Yesu. Aywo nhundwa yungi kakibhegha kangumanyikwa kwa Ndundame Nkulu, habhu kakiyingila papamu na Yesu mbaka mu ludamu lwa Ndundame Nkulu.
Peni Petili kakiyima panje ugheghela na nlyango. Hino aywo nhundwa yungi kakibhuya kuyobhela na ndumindumi nhinja ywakalindila kuhughula nlyango kantegheke Petili kayingile unyumba.
Yula nhinja ywakalindila kuhughula nlyango kakinkonya Petili, “Na ghwenga ndo chepa yumu ywa ahundwa bhake mundu ayu?” Petili kakiyanga, “Chepa nenga.”
Limjubha alyo kukibhegha na malili, andumindumi na akingikiha bhakiyaha mwoto na bhakiyima na kuyotela mwoto. Naywo Petili kakiyima papamo na bhombe kanguyotela mwoto.
Ndundame Nkulu kangunkonya Yesu
Hino, Ndundame Nkulu kakinkonya Yesu kulinga mihalo ya ahundwa bhake na mahundo ghake.

Yesu kakinnyanga, “Nikibhegha panyobhela manjubha ghoha na bhandu bhoha pakindandabhanji maghenda maghenda, na nikihunda nyumba hya kukonganila Ayahudi na ku Nyumba ya Chapanga, kwene kwaakonganite Akaayahudi bhoha. Hangi nikilongela ng'obhe nhalo ghwohele kwa kihiho.
Kya bhuli ghungungonya nenga? Ghubhakonye bhala bahaanyihwite ghala ghaniaghombilite, bhombe bhangumanya ghaniaghombilite.”
Pakayomolite kulongela agha, yumu ywa machonda ywakayimite ugheghela naywo kakimbhakula mbande Yesu mu kibhungi, na kakilongela, “Ghungunnyanga Ndundame nkulu?”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Handa nongela nnando nhakato, ghulongele aghwo uhakata ghunongelite. Peni handa nongela ghaghabheghite hoto, bhuli ghumakula nenga?”
Hino, Anasi kakinnyegha Yesu kwa Ndundame Nkulu Kayafa, kakibhegha kakali kabhopwa.
Petili kangulongela kangummanya ng'obhe Yesu

Lisaa alyo Simoni Petili kakiyima apo kanguyotela mwoto. Amu ywa bhala bhaayimite pala kakinkonya, “Bhuli, na ghwenga chepa yumu ywa ahundwa bhake?” Ywombe kaking'aka na kulongela, “Aka kaa, nenga chepa”
Yumu ywa andumindumi bha Ndundame Nkulu, nnongo ywake yula mundu ywene Petili kakinkechula lichikilo, kakinkonya, “Ghwenga nikighubhona ng'obhe kula ku kitogholo papamu na Yesu?”
Petili kaking'aka kangi pa ubhili, kamu mbichi kakibhika.
Yesu kanguyeghwa kwa Pilato

Mbole Akaayahudi bhakintola Yesu kuhuma kwa Kayafa mbaka ku nyumba kya ntabhala ywa Akaalumi, nayo yikibha malabhila putiputi, peni bhombe bhakiyingila ng'obhe munyumba ayo, bhakiyoghopa kiyaha bhalemwe kuyitikilwa kkuntundamila Chapanga na kulyegha kikubhukubhu kya Pasaka.
Kya habhu Pilato kakiaghendela panji na kakiakonya, “Katenda uhokelo ghani mundu ayu mbaka nhike kunkokela kwa nenga?”
Bhombe bhakinnyanga, “handa mundu ayu kakabheghite ng'obhe na uhokelo, twenga tungannyeghite ng'obhe kwa ghwenga.”
Hino, Pilato kakiaghombela, “Hino muntole mwenga, mukantose kubhukana na Malaghilo ghenu.” Bhombe Akaayahudi bhakinnyanga, “Twenga Malaghilo ghetu ghangutukanikiha kuntosa mundu ywohele kuhwegha.”
Akaayahudi bhakilongela habhu ili ghala malagho ghakalongilite Yesu kulinga kiho kyakapala kuhwegha ghatwihilike.
Pilato kakiyingila kangi unyumba na kakinkema Yesu, na kakinkonya. “Bhuli, ghwenga ndo Mutwa ywa Akaayahudi?”
Yesu kakinnyanga Pilato, “Ghwenga ghungukonya naha kwa mahwacho ghako ebu ghubhayihwa bhandu bhangi bhaghughombela mihalo yangu?”
Pilato kakiyanga, “Bhuli, nenga nu Nnyahudi? Bhandu bha nnima ghwako ghumwene na hilongohi bha mandundame ndo bhaghuyegha kwa nenga. Ghutenda uhokelo ghani?”

Yesu kakilongela, “Ghubhutwa ghwangu chepa ghwa nnima aghu, handa ghubhutwa ghwangu ghungabheghite ghwa nnima aghu, andumitumi bhangu bhangangomanilite, ili ngotoke kuyingihwa mu makakala gha Akaayahudi. Aka kaa, ghubhutwa ghwangu chepa ghwa apa!”

Hinu Pilato kakinkonya Yesu, “Kya habhu ghwenga ndo mutwa?” Yesu kakiyanga, “Ghwenga ghungulongela kukita nenga ndo mutwa. Nenga nikibhelekwa na kuhika pa nnima kwakya agha, na kwakya agha nikihika pannima ili nuaghombele uhoto bhandu bha nnima. Bhandu bhoha bhaabheghite bha uhoto bhanguyihwa lilobhe lyangu.”

Pilato kakinkonya Yesu, “Uhoto ndo niki?” Yesu kangutoswa kuhwegha Matayu 27:15-31; Maliki 15:6-20; Lukasi 23:13-25 Mbole ya kulongela agha, Pilato kakighenda kangi panji na kakiaghombela bhala hilongohi bha Akaayahudi, “Nughubhona ng'obhe uhokelo kwa mundu ayu.
Peni kwa mwenga Makaayahudi mmegha na mahyobhelelo ghenu, kukita mu kikubhukubhu kya Pasaka nubhahughulile mmopwa yumu. Bhuli, mungupala nubhahughulile mutwa ywa Akaayahudi?”
Habhu Akaayahudi bhakiyobha kyobho paalongela, “Aka kaa, chepa ayu, tungunpala Balaba!” Naywo Balaba kakibhegha mpoka.
